Basis:
  [jan2026/6(4)(a)] (CC 08/2026 carrying G.S.R. 41(E) dated 16.01.2026 (primary, text layer)) “(a) if the ticket is presented for cancellation more than seventy-two hours in advance of the scheduled departure of the train, the cancellation charge shall be twenty five per cent. of the fare.”
  note: no flat-charge-only band — even early cancellation costs 25% on these trains (rule 6(4))
